# Preclaude

> Preclaude is a free, open-source (MIT) enhancement pack for Claude Code — Anthropic's CLI coding agent. One install adds 42 slash commands, 18 specialist agents, 11 auto-loading skills, and the Ralph autonomous build loop: production-ready workflows covering project kickoff, PRD generation, autonomous building, code quality, and growth marketing. Made by Precode (https://precode.co), a UK digital product agency.

Install (as a Claude Code plugin): `/plugin marketplace add weareprecode/preclaude` then `/plugin install preclaude@preclaude`.
Or one-liner: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/weareprecode/preclaude/main/install-remote.sh | bash`

Key facts:
- Works with Claude Code (CLI, desktop, and IDE extensions). Not affiliated with Anthropic.
- 42 slash commands across five groups: Plan & Build (/kickoff, /prd, /prd-json, /full-build, /build, /implement, /research, /landscape), Ship & Maintain (/commit, /pr, /review, /test, /debug, /status, /polish, /refactor, /migrate, /deps, /deploy-check), Growth Toolkit (/offer, /valueladder, /moneymodel, /dream100, /adfactory, /nurture, /webinar, /emailseq, /copy, /marketing), Marketing Engine (/demo, /atomise, /launch, /listen, /scorecard, /ugc), and Project Ops (/seo, /analytics, /stakeholder, /project-complete, /handoff, /learn, /update).
- 18 specialist agents invoked with @name, e.g. @frontend-developer, @backend-developer, @security-auditor, @ai-engineer, @copywriter, @data-analyst.
- Ralph is an autonomous build loop: convert a PRD to prd.json of atomic user stories, then Claude Code implements them story-by-story with quality gates and commits.
- The Growth Toolkit encodes classic direct-response frameworks (offer stacks, value ladders, ad-creative volume testing, webinar scripts, story-driven email sequences) as ready-to-run commands.
- The Marketing Engine is an optional module producing drafts only — it never auto-publishes.
